parameters.content:
## Choose a business type
Use the dropdown or select Other business or service and enter your own.
Location and offer remain editable. The request form belongs to this n8n workflow.
No separate campaign dashboard is required.

## Save and review in n8n
The workflow creates/reuses AwtomateAI Campaign Review Queue.
Existing domains are skipped, preserving your drafts, contact history and do-not-contact entries.
Run one research batch at a time.

## Automatic discovery and retry loop
Blank or already-known websites trigger new searches. Up to 6 attempts with a 2-second pause. Blocked providers are skipped for the rest of the run.
Serper mode needs a Header Auth credential with X-API-KEY. Public mode can be blocked by robots or CAPTCHA. SEARCH_BLOCKED does not mean no businesses exist.

## Local AI, then human review
Ollama runs one business at a time. Evidence must match the selected business type and location.
Open Review Drafts in n8n for results. No email, call, ad or social post is sent.

nodes.name: Search API - Serper
nodes.notes: Select a Header Auth credential: Name X-API-KEY; Value your Serper key without Bearer. Configure this credential before running Serper discovery. Crawl4AI and Ollama remain local.
